case.summary: Case HHG-017 was triggered by a risk score of 0.57 on online transaction 3450629 ($100.09) for cardholder C04570 on card C04570-K1. Investigation showed the device profile (Windows 10, Chrome 65.0) was already used twice by this cardholder before the alert, despite the anonymous proxy. The case-memory model scored the transaction at 0.02, and the final fraud probability is 0.04. The transaction is deemed legitimate, and the case is closed with no fraud.
